cues: Welcome to Class 12 Physics, Unit 13: Polarization.
Interference and diffraction showed us that light is a wave.
Polarization tells us what kind of wave.
We will see how polarized light is produced, and learn the two laws the exam always asks for: Brewster's law and Malus's law.
